summary: Frees the data-array pointer held at descriptor offset +8, then frees the descriptor itself at this+0x1E0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, clears the descriptor pointer to 0, and returns the freed descriptor address (or null when this+0x1E0 was already null).

operations.description: If the descriptor pointer at this+0x1E0 is null, return null without freeing anything.
Free the data-array pointer stored at descriptor offset +8 (the descriptor is at this+0x1E0; the packet maps the data-array slot to this+0x1E8) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Free the descriptor itself at this+0x1E0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, retaining its address as the return value.
Clear the descriptor pointer at this+0x1E0 to 0.
Return the freed descriptor address (or null when this+0x1E0 was already null).
Called by SceneGraph and VertexParticleBufferAllocator on the frame path.
